exercise: Junior AI Engineer take-home, alternative A: AI Order Intake & Exception Handling

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code 2.1.308 in the Claude desktop app (Code tab) on Windows 11, model claude-opus-5-5 (user setting opus[1m]), effort high, other settings default. Sessions: planning 2026-10-23, build 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-24, and a fork of the build session used only to explain the data flow (no file changes). Local tools: uv 0.8.9, just 1.59.0, pre-commit 4.7.0, Python 3.12.11.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: Used: the desktop app's built-in browser pane (UI check; dev server from launch.json) and inline diagrams (explanations only). Installed but not used: plugin understand-anything, Claude in Chrome, claude.ai connectors (Claude Docs, Google Drive).

application_models_and_parameters.notes: OpenAI Chat Completions via the official async SDK (openai 3.37.0). Model gpt-4.1-mini (responses report gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14), temperature 0, max_completion_tokens 1024, timeout 60 s, 1 SDK retry, 5 catalog searches per email then a forced answer. Tool schema and response format generated from Pydantic. MODEL_MODE=replay (default) serves saved real responses labelled cached; R11 is a labelled simulated failure.

skills.notes: Starter-pack skill, unchanged, used once in the data step. Its paths refer to tasks/orders/; in this repo those files are in data/seed/ (noted in CLAUDE.md). The user-level context7-mcp skill was available but the MCP tools were called directly.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: Project CLAUDE.md (architecture, domain rules, model boundaries, workflow), user-level CLAUDE.md (Windows environment, version pinning) and one auto-memory note (PowerShell 5.1 syntax for the candidate's commands). No custom agents or subagent definitions; no subagents were spawned.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: Git pre-commit hooks only, installed with `uv run pre-commit install`, run on every git commit: frozen data/seed, expected-data check, ruff format, ruff check, mypy, pytest. No Claude Code hooks were configured.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Application prompt extract-v2 (v1 in commit 25941fa, v2 in 1a2c8b9); its hash is stored with every model call. User-level rule: look up library docs through Context7.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Context7 MCP server, HTTP, user scope, https://mcp.context7.com/mcp, used for FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, pytest-asyncio, OpenAI Python SDK and htmx docs. Its CONTEXT7_API_KEY header is redacted.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Project permissions allow the gate, migration and read-only git commands and deny reading .env, editing data/seed/**, git commit and git push. Unrelated user-level permissions (other projects, Docker, other websites) are omitted.
